announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.4 — Plugin SketchUp 1.12.0: alat baru ARA Line (weld garis pintar 1 klik, sambung celah, sederhanakan & haluskan kurva) dan ARA Face (tempel model ke bidang datar/lengkung/bola tanpa garis bantu, kisi & sirip, fluted, ubin & parket termasuk bata dan batu alam acak, perforasi yang lubangnya bisa membentuk logo/foto, gradasi parametrik, Edit Titik, Haluskan, Hitung jumlah ubin/bilah/lubang + dus, dan Bentangkan ke lembar datar + SVG). Plugin diperbarui otomatis saat ARA dibuka. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.4 — SketchUp plugin 1.12.0: new ARA Line tool (one-click smart weld, close gaps, simplify & smooth curves) and ARA Face (apply a model to flat, curved or spherical faces without guide lines, slats & fins, fluted, tiles & parquet incl. brick and random natural stone, perforation whose holes can form a logo/photo, parametric gradients, Edit Vertices, Subdivide, Count tiles/slats/holes + boxes, and Unroll to a flat sheet + SVG). The plugin updates automatically when ARA opens. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
